{{Quote|You said in a status report that Tharston had a weakness for sabacc, correct?"<br />"Yes, he went to the casinos on Valnoos every month, whenever he had a recreation break.|[[Vestara Khai|Savara Raine]] and [[Dena Yus]]|<ref name="C" />}}
'''Valnoos''' was a world in the [[Morshdine sector/Legends|Morshdine sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. In [[45 ABY]], it was home to several [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] which were attended by [[Miner/Legends|miners]] in the rift, including [[Tharston Kharl]]. The most notable of the casinos on Valnoos was the [[Blue Star]], which was the site of an [[Firefight at the Blue Star casino|assassination attempt]] on the lives of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] by the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] brothers, [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]].<ref name="C" />
